integrationScope: Source adaptations of page/session, snapshots, action/input/navigation, tool contracts and console/network/screenshot/script observation code. Piskie retains BrowserManager, public Skill SDK, feedback/screen and workspace/temp file ownership. The version identifies the source release; chrome-devtools-mcp is not an npm runtime dependency and no MCP server runtime is redistributed.
hashScope: SHA-256 values identify immutable upstream source files. Evolving local implementation files are listed by path and adaptation scope without local content digests.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Page routing, selection, named contexts and collector access
derivedFiles.modifications: Exposes the fixed page/context behavior through a BrowserManager-owned session; delegates persistent page identity and selection to PageRegistry, and retains Piskie's cancellation, call targeting and display feedback.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Page-scoped snapshots, current-snapshot UID lookup, dialogs, action boundary and text waiting
derivedFiles.modifications: Stores snapshot and identity state per registered page and routes optional page IDs to the actual Page; replaces MCP page wrappers with host session methods and ActionReceipt values while retaining the source lookup and observation boundaries.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: UID actions, single/batch fill, interruption attribution, type/press/drag and upload
derivedFiles.modifications: Adapts input dispatch to the host session/input driver; single and batch fill share a sequential loop under one outer wait, preserve interrupted UID attribution, and propagate the host execution signal. Upload retains its separate no-outer-wait path.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Page identity, selection and closed-page fallback, named BrowserContexts, enumeration and creation
derivedFiles.modifications: Consolidates stable page IDs, selection fallback and isolated-context ownership in the existing host registry; applies the fixed default URL policy at registration and keeps SDK page-index access as a local adapter.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Page dialog observation and page-scoped console/network owner lifecycle
derivedFiles.modifications: Adapts page-scoped observation and cleanup to registry records and host events, with one page console/network collector pair and the existing browser-scoped service-worker collector owner.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Snapshot traversal, loader/backend identity reuse and pruning, DevTools-selected backend lookup
derivedFiles.modifications: Uses a host-owned per-page identity map and explicit snapshot results; preserves optional protocol identity components, reuses continuously observed UIDs and prunes nodes missing from the new snapshot.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Current-snapshot UID lookup and backend-node element restoration
derivedFiles.modifications: Provides transport-free UID resolution against the supplied page snapshot and actual Page; preserves the source missing-UID and restoration behavior without a UID prefix check.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Default accessibility text attributes, states and selected-element annotation
derivedFiles.modifications: Formats the host TextSnapshotResult directly, retaining source text ordering and optional DevTools selection markers while omitting MCP response objects.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Pre-dispatch navigation setup, complete-action probes, dialog signal and post-action navigation/DOM waits
derivedFiles.modifications: Replaces source logging, response dependencies and disposable syntax with explicit host cleanup, cancellation and ActionReceipt values; navigation probes are installed before dispatch and the action/dialog signal reaches the input operation.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Native click/hover options, typing and submit key, key modifiers, drag/drop delay and multi-file upload
derivedFiles.modifications: Transfers input fragments into Piskie's existing input driver, retaining mouse observation, geometry and pointer ordering; modifiers are released in finally and file-root checks remain supplied by the host.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: isAllowedUrl default categoryExtensions=false predicate
derivedFiles.modifications: Extracts the fixed default URL predicate as a dependency-free helper with no runtime options; retains source scheme parsing, restricted-page exclusions and newtab/new-tab-page/inspect exceptions.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: navigate_page URL/back/forward/reload, initScript, beforeunload and success/Unable text
derivedFiles.modifications: Routes navigation to the actual target page under BrowserManager exclusivity and returns structured host results plus source message text; retains init-script registration/removal and nonpositive timeout normalization.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Bounded optional page-title read
derivedFiles.modifications: Adapts the source timed title lookup to the host BrowserNavigationResult while leaving cookie/window operations under the existing host contract.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Page list/new/select/close/navigation and dialog handlers
derivedFiles.modifications: Adapts the fixed handlers to stable page-ID session calls and host locks, retaining source messages, selection/context labels, explicit bringToFront and tool-specific dialog behavior; browser-level administration remains host-owned.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Click/hover/fill/fill_form/type_text/press_key/drag/upload_file handlers
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains fixed arguments, success text and recognized dialog-interruption branches through direct session calls; requested snapshots are collected only on the source handler paths, and upload checks all host-authorized paths.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: take_snapshot and wait_for handlers
derivedFiles.modifications: Uses the shared per-page snapshot formatter, optional host .txt output and any-text waiting; replaces MCP request/response bindings with direct host results.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Default non-slim screenshot handler
derivedFiles.modifications: Delegates to the target-page screenshot helper; forwards image MIME/base64 through the existing Skill image channel or returns source explicit/large-file text using host workspace/temp roots.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Nonextension evaluate_script handler
derivedFiles.modifications: Delegates UID/frame/function/file/dialog/DOM options to the page evaluation helper, using the existing host output envelope and injected page action wait.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Console list/detail handler options and result paths
derivedFiles.modifications: Passes filters, preserved navigation, pagination, stack and service-worker options to the actual page collector helpers; supplies host file roots and request/element resolvers from current network data and snapshots.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Network list/detail handler options and selected-request behavior
derivedFiles.modifications: Delegates filters, paging, preserved requests, optional DevTools selection and body files to target-page helpers with host file roots.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Default page-list, snapshot heading, result text and dialog formatting
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains default human-readable text, latest-page headings, selected/context labels and consumed closed-selection notices; replaces MCP Content and structuredContent transport objects with host strings and image outputs.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: isAllowedUrl default categoryExtensions=false validation
derivedFiles.modifications: Shares the extracted fixed URL predicate for new-page and navigation validation through the host session helper.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Page and dialog schemas and descriptions
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains fixed page IDs, navigation/context/background/initScript/beforeunload parameters and descriptions while injecting private browser identity and host cancellation outside model input.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Input schemas, UID arguments and includeSnapshot options
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains fixed input names, fields, defaults, descriptions and ranges, including batch-fill, submitKey and multiple upload paths; supplies trusted host file roots outside model input.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Snapshot and any-text wait schemas
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains source snapshot verbosity/file parameters and any-text wait input through the trusted Skill definition.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Screenshot format/quality/UID/fullPage/file schema
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains the fixed screenshot input schema and forwards host image outputs through the existing Skill result channel.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Nonextension function/UID/file/dialog/DOM evaluation schema
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains the fixed JavaScript evaluation fields and descriptions in the trusted Skill contract.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Console list/detail filters, paging, preserved data, stack and service-worker schemas
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains the fixed console filter enums and source fields through direct trusted Skill definitions.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Network list/detail resource filters, paging, preserved data and body-file schemas
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains the fixed network field names, enums and optional request/body-file parameters in the trusted Skill definition.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Default non-slim schema construction with pageIdRouting=true
derivedFiles.modifications: Adapts source schema/routing injection to the trusted Skill schema: 22 upstream-equivalent functions, JavaScript enabled and extension tools disabled. Private browser identity, workspace/temp roots and cancellation come from the host; seven existing browser-level functions retain their host contracts.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Console/network IDs, navigation buckets and limits, main-frame rebinding, issues and Runtime exceptions
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains stable IDs and three preserved navigation buckets with source console/network limits; binds actual fixed frontend issue mapping/aggregation and primary Runtime exceptions to the existing per-page collector, using explicit host teardown.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Concise/detailed console text, arguments/errors, grouping, stacks, causes and ignore-list notes
derivedFiles.modifications: Adapts source formatting to the local collector/stack interfaces and fixed frontend model, retaining available mapped stacks, adjacent grouping, stack limits and exact notes without MCP response objects.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Request/status/URL text, headers, bodies and files, truncation and redirects
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains source header/body markers, 10,000-character inline limit and distinct request-write versus response-write failure behavior; uses host observation file helpers and the source default redactHeaders=false behavior.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: All-items mode, default page size 20, zero-based paging and invalid-page fallback
derivedFiles.modifications: Keeps source pagination as a transport-free helper over host arrays, including out-of-range fallback to the first page.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: dataWithPagination human-readable result text
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains source pagination lines while omitting MCP Content and structuredContent response objects.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Console list/detail filters and service-worker lookup
derivedFiles.modifications: Provides four transport-free console/network result helpers over existing collectors; retains console filters, worker-specific IDs, preserved buckets, grouping, stacks and host file output options.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Network list/detail filters and optional DevTools selected request
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains source request filtering, preserved buckets, paging and optional panel selection; uses the actual target-page network collector and host body-file options.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Console/network list/detail, empty text, pagination and issue resources
derivedFiles.modifications: Adapts source data text paths to local formatters and actual collectors, resolving issue request IDs and latest snapshot node IDs through supplied host resolvers.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Default unconfigured, non-slim screenshot capture and result paths
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains unscaled PNG viewport defaults, format/quality/UID/fullPage behavior, image MIME/base64 and explicit or >=2,000,000-byte file output; injects host roots/temp/cancellation and explicitly disposes owned element handles.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Nonextension page evaluation, UID-derived frame and action waiting
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains function/async execution, UID arguments, one derived frame or Page, cross-frame errors, JSON/undefined/file results and dialogAction/DOM options; uses one injected page action wait, host files/cancellation and explicit owned-handle cleanup.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: ensureExtension, writeFile, saveFile and saveTemporaryFile
derivedFiles.modifications: Replaces MCP roots/cwd and temporary-directory ownership with host workspace/temp roots; preserves source extension replacement, canonical-path validation, O_NOFOLLOW/0600 writes and write-error causes.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: getDevToolsPage and getDevToolsData
derivedFiles.modifications: Exposes transport-free reads of an already-open DevTools panel; checks hasDevTools before openDevTools, retains request/backend-node selection and returns empty data when unavailable.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Extension service-worker subscriptions, storage, IDs, lookup and disposal
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains separate worker IDs and the default 1,000-log limit, missing-worker lookup behavior and extension-origin filtering; integrates subscriptions, in-flight attach cleanup and explicit teardown with the registry-owned collector.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Optional DevTools observation initialization/disposal
derivedFiles.modifications: Creates one secondary observation CDP session owned by the existing page console collector, retaining source best-effort initialization and explicit release.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: loadResource HTTP(S)/file resource loading
derivedFiles.modifications: Adapts source-map resource loading to fetch and host-authorized file roots provided by the current observation context.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Scoped DevTools observation model connection
derivedFiles.modifications: Uses the separately built fixed frontend observation graph and local stack model interface rather than the full source Universe; observation session lifecycle remains with the page collector.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: SymbolizedError remote message, stack and cause resolution
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains uncaught/error message parsing and available stack/cause lookup through the fixed frontend observation model, using a local structural interface and source best-effort stack behavior.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Issue concise/detail text and affected resources
derivedFiles.modifications: Retains fixed titles, counts, links and source invalid-issue handling; clones affected resource data and resolves requests/nodes using actual host collector/snapshot resolvers.

derivedFiles.sourceScope: Markdown description loading, titles and substitutions
derivedFiles.modifications: Loads the 255 fixed frontend descriptions relative to emitted host modules and delegates title/placeholders to the fixed frontend observation subset.

hostIntegrationFiles.sourceScope: Consumption of the adapted page action boundary
hostIntegrationFiles.modifications: Piskie-owned integration: retains browser process/connection lifecycle and per-browser locking; forwards page IDs, cancellation and optional feedback to the adapted session. This entry describes host use of the derived session, not copied McpPage source in the manager.

hostIntegrationFiles.sourceScope: Consumption of adapted stable page identity and selection
hostIntegrationFiles.modifications: Piskie-owned integration: retains the public Skill SDK page-index contract and resolves indices to registered page IDs for target scopes; passive SDK reads leave feedback inactive. This entry describes host use of the derived registry, not copied MCP context source in the SDK.

hostIntegrationFiles.sourceScope: Consumption of the adapted session page target
hostIntegrationFiles.modifications: Piskie-owned integration: retains ScreenStreamHub and screen capture/stream ownership; follows the session display target, handles a null target and restores the registry selection after call feedback. This entry describes host use of the derived session, not copied MCP page source in the screen hub.

frontendAdaptations.sourceScope: DevTools bootstrap, protocol observation and source-map/stack dependencies
frontendAdaptations.modifications: Adapts the observation dependencies of source initialization to a pure Node scoped model graph with host resource loading and explicit observation/formatter teardown.

frontendAdaptations.sourceScope: Frontend host resource-loading bridge and default host methods
frontendAdaptations.modifications: Adapts the host resource bridge to the local Node observation bootstrap; stream writes and callback status handling use the fixed frontend HostRuntime and the page collector resource loader.

frontendAdaptations.sourceScope: Runtime/locales shims; CodeMirror shim additionally contributes to observation.js
frontendAdaptations.modifications: Extracts the source Node build shims while building the separately pinned frontend subset; worker URLs are bundle-relative and wasm worker messaging uses the existing Node HostRuntime workerScope. Frontend input, runtime artifact and issue-resource hashes are maintained in the sibling frontend provenance record.
